reason: Independent audit found a correct answer.txt with FAILED status (new_blocked_grid baseline). Organizer rules specify submitted answer files and sum of task rewards, not internal status. The original normalized-SOLVED criterion was our surrogate, not organizer scoring.
original_criterion: Maximize sum of score/max_score across the three equally weighted suite-budget cells; ties minimize summed actual token cost. No no-regression or zero-wrong-answer gate.
corrected_criterion: Sum reward for correct saved answer artifacts under the identical suite budgets, regardless of internal status; tie-break actual token cost.
limitation: Known answer/file check is still a proxy for organizer hidden tests. No assumption of hidden-set distribution.
